from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial figure extracted from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the financial line item (e.g., 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable and other accrued expenses')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the figure")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'actual')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data_points: list[FinancialDataPoint]
